description.narrative: This project intends to improve food security through multi -purpose cash assistance; improved protection for survivors of sexual gender based violence through cash assistance, medical assistance and legal recourse; improved public health outcomes through access to clean water and hygiene promotion; and improved timeliness, effectiveness and efficiency of the response through strengthened coordination with humanitarian actors, county governments and the National Drought Management Authority. in addition, in 2025 the project will support AHN Women's Caucus at ensuring the continuity of critical protection and GBV services, particularly those affected by recent USAID funding cuts.
